ablation.note: the first N of the same five samples are reused at every level, so the differences between levels are due to sample count and not to drawing a different sample set

A.note: logprobs come back with the greedy answer, so family A is free

B.note: 5 sampled generations plus one NLI clustering pass over the sample set

C.note: one extra scoring pass for P(True) or one short generation

T.note: computed from text already in hand

cost.unit: multiple of the single greedy answer every signal requires

primary.note: every signal is scored on this exact row set; per-signal gaps are recorded as missing_n rather than by dropping rows

with_abstentions.note: every signal is scored on this exact row set; per-signal gaps are recorded as missing_n rather than by dropping rows

a_first_token_logprob.description: logprob of the first answer token

a_first_token_margin.description: p(top1) - p(top2) at the first answer position

a_length_normalized_logprob.description: total logprob under the Wu et al. length penalty

a_mean_logprob.description: mean per-token logprob over the answer span

a_mean_top5_entropy.description: mean truncated predictive entropy over answer positions

a_min_logprob.description: least-likely answer token; the weakest link in the span

a_perplexity.description: exp(-mean logprob) over the answer span

a_total_logprob.description: sum of answer-token logprobs, i.e. log P(answer)

b_disagreement_rate.description: fraction of samples whose normalized answer differs from greedy

b_distinct_count.description: number of distinct normalized answers in the answer set

b_distinct_fraction.description: distinct count divided by answer-set size

b_mean_pairwise_f1.description: mean token F1 over all unordered pairs in the answer set

b_semantic_entropy_normalized.description: semantic entropy divided by ln(answer-set size)

c_p_true_plain.description: renormalized P(True) shown only the proposed answer

c_p_true_with_samples.description: renormalized P(True) also shown the N sampled answers

t_random.description: seeded uniform noise; the null signal

gates.detail: the random baseline brackets chance, so the bootstrap interval is wide enough to be believed
gates.name: random_baseline_ci_contains_chance

gates.detail: both classes are large enough for the ranking to be powered
gates.name: minimum_rows_per_class

gates.detail: few enough refusals that the table is not measuring refusal detection
gates.name: abstention_rate_below_ceiling

combination.note: out-of-fold predictions pooled then scored once; features standardized on training folds only

length_confound.verdict: b_distinct_count keeps AUROC 0.678 in its weaker length stratum against 0.704 pooled, so it is not purely a length proxy

significance.delong_substitution_reason: DeLong's analytic variance assumes untied scores; several signals here are integer-valued with heavy ties, so a paired bootstrap was used instead
significance.test: paired stratified bootstrap on the AUROC difference
significance.test_detail: 10000 resamples, identical resample indices applied to both signals, two-sided achieved significance level, Holm-Bonferroni across 20 comparisons at alpha=0.05

verdict.reason: no winner: b_distinct_count leads b_distinct_fraction by 0.000 AUROC, CIs overlap at n=120
